en: The image shows an old sepia-toned postcard depicting a large, two-story building with signage advertising a Bier- & Wein-Stuben (beer and wine parlor) and a restaurant called 'Wachtel' operated by Bruno Teuchert. The building is surrounded by a garden, fence, and entrance archway labeled 'Garten-Restaurant Wachtel.' There are several people, including children, standing at the entrance and on the street. The postcard has the printed text 'Spaar - Meissen' in the upper left corner.
